svg.aria-label: Two number lines for the guide's example: the shared parameter Θ is 10 and two workers end at 8 and 6, so their outer gradients are 2 and 4, with mean 3. With plain outer SGD at learning rate 1, Θ moves by 3 to 7, the average of the workers. With Nesterov momentum at learning rate 0.7 and momentum 0.9, and a momentum of 3 left by an earlier round, the momentum becomes 5.7 and Θ moves by 5.69 to 4.31, past both workers.
svg.text: The step is the mean outer gradient, so Θ lands on the average of the workers.
With a momentum m = 3 left by an earlier round, the step carries it and passes both workers.
